title: Lifelong Opportunity Guides: Multilingual Career and Education Guide Library
description: A free multilingual library of 101 practical career and education guides, numbered 00 through 100, created and directed by Alberto "Al" Leiva. The guides support students, career changers, older adults, people with disabilities, workers seeking advancement, families, and community organizations with plain-language career pathways, free-first learning options, accessibility guidance, responsible-AI guidance, and verification through current official sources. This dated Zenodo snapshot reflects the controlled 2026 revision program through Guide 96; Guide 97 and later controlled revisions remain in progress. Languages: English, neutral Latin American Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese.
